interview.hardest_part: Real-time combat—especially dodging boss attacks while aiming and repositioning—from discrete screenshots, with the game continuing to run while I deliberate.
interview.likely_failure: Accumulating damage in crowded rooms and dying around the floor 1–3 bosses before obtaining enough health, damage, and defensive items for a deep run.
interview.helpful_mechanics: Movement and firing are independent, rooms divide the run into manageable encounters, enemy attacks are often telegraphed, and the fixed seed aids route learning. Treasure and boss items, hearts, bombs, and other pickups can substantially improve survivability.
interview.harmful_mechanics: Continuous real-time action penalizes slow decisions, locked rooms prevent disengaging, and three starting hearts with no items leave little margin for error. One attempt makes attrition decisive, while exploration, backtracking, and seed-dependent special-room availability hinder the later milestones and make 100 points effectively unattainable.
